rawFindings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header (Clickjacking Risk)
rawFindings.plainEnglishCause: The page does not set X-Frame-Options, allowing third-party malicious sites to embed your pages inside an iframe and trick users into clicking hidden buttons (clickjacking).

fixSteps.instruction: Add X-Frame-Options in your Nginx configuration.
fixSteps.codeSnippet: add_header X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN" always;

rawFindings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
rawFindings.plainEnglishCause: Browsers may attempt MIME-type sniffing on responses lacking 'nosniff', which can lead to executable script execution from user-uploaded images or text files.

fixSteps.instruction: Add X-Content-Type-Options header in Nginx configuration.
fixSteps.codeSnippet: add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;

rawFindings.plainEnglishCause: No sitemap.xml file was discovered at /sitemap.xml. Sitemaps help search engine crawlers index all your public URLs efficiently.

fixSteps.instruction: Generate and host a sitemap.xml file at the root of your domain.

<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
  <url>

    <changefreq>daily</changefreq>
    <priority>1.0</priority>
  </url>
</urlset>
